name: io.github.fish827-08/kb-memory
title: kb — Local Memory & Knowledge Service
description: Local-first agent memory and knowledge service: hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 normalized fusion) with optional memory governance (semantic dedup, decay, freshness). Single process, works fully offline without any LLM. Default embedding model is lightweight (bge-small-zh-v1.5, ~92 MB); bge-m3 is opt-in. Store memories and documents via REST or MCP, search them from Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client. Run `python -m kb serve` from the repository to expose the local MCP endpoint.
